content.text:
I now have enough information to report the findings. Here is the audit:

---

**Beta Hero (`beta-hero.tsx` vs `beta.html`)**

The implementation is accurate on all critical content:
- Badge text: "Beta Access Open — Limited Spots Remaining" matches.
- H1: "Your Agency's Execution Team. Ownership Driven." matches (implementation uses `h1`, Webflow also uses `h1.web-ban-title`).
- Subtitle paragraph matches word-for-word.
- All 4 stat badges (icons + labels) match exactly.

No content differences found in the hero. The structural wrapping differs (`div.div-white-bag > section.how-works-banner.beta-ban > div.div-stuck-swept > div.div-wrote-smoke` in Webflow vs a single `section` in implementation), but this is an acceptable conversion pattern.

**Beta Pricing (`beta-pricing.tsx` vs `beta.html`)**

Pricing content is correct: Beta Lite $299, Beta Pro $599, all features, taglines, checkout URLs, and "Most Popular" badge match. One minor flag: the Webflow source uses `h1` for the section heading ("Try Boldteq completely risk-free" under `.pricing-ban-title`) but the implementation downgrades it to `h2` — this is intentional and acceptable for heading hierarchy (avoids two `h1`s on the page).

**Newsletter Page (`src/app/newsletter/page.tsx` vs `newsletter.html`)**

This is the biggest discrepancy. The Webflow `newsletter.html` body content is essentially a **placeholder/template page** — it contains generic filler text: overline says "Overline text", h3 says "Add your call to action header here", paragraph says "A short and simple subheading can be added here". The form itself is a plain email input + "Subscribe" button with no surrounding branded context. The real newsletter content lives in the **footer newsletter card** (which repeats across all pages), not in the dedicated newsletter page.

The current implementation uses `PageHero` with properly branded copy ("Agency Growth Insights Delivered Monthly") and the `NewsletterSignup` shared component — this is **more correct than the Webflow source**, which has unfinished placeholder content. The implementation correctly derives its heading and subtitle from the footer newsletter card copy (`news-heading` + `paragraph-small-4`), which is the only real branded newsletter content in the Webflow export.

**Footer (first 60 lines)**

The footer implementation correctly recreates all three social SVG icons (LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook) with exact path data matching the Webflow HTML. No differences detected in the portion reviewed.

**Summary of actionable gaps:**
- No blocking content errors in beta hero or pricing.
- Newsletter page copy is better than Webflow source (Webflow page was left as placeholder); implementation is correct.
- If strict pixel-fidelity on `beta.html` hero wrapper class structure matters, the outer `div.div-white-bag > section.how-works-banner.beta-ban` background/gradient styling from `boldteq-v1-0.webflow.css` may not be applied in the CSS module — worth verifying the hero background appearance matches the live site.
